acceptance_criteria: An adult signs in on a phone, makes a game by text, watches stills arrive, plays the draft, edits while a second build runs, branches, invites a family member into a room, and publishes, with every service on this machine and no money spent.
Every requirement in requirements.md has one disposition; every ticket is merged, green on main, and documented.
end_to_end_proof: OGM-100 acceptance checklist with recorded clips
feature_boundary.completion_condition: OGM-100 passes on current main with its evidence committed; the deferred-findings ledger holds everything else.
